question: Given a folder of single-cell RNA-seq expression data output by cellranger, identify the top 10 marker genes per cluster (filtered to avg_log2FC > 1) compared to all other cells.

expected_output.guidelines: Top 10 marker genes per cluster must match the reference in gene identity; avg_log2FC and p_val_adj values must match within 1% relative absolute error; column order, row order, and cluster label integers may differ.
